items.note: The lemma and its whole proof (rows 0-1 subtract Ja+Rc, net change (JV+RG)x, the central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2, the three stages giving (-y,x)) are reproduced from 741-765. But h=100 is never fixed, and the neighbour and wire counts of 767-783 (z_b, z_c, c_b=100, c_c=101, W_b, W_c) are reduced to 'fixed numbers' in S2.3.6. These counts set W and the loss ratio L/N=3ch/v, so the derivation is partial.

S0 asserts that the bound 'disproves the n log n optimality conjecture in this model', and S1/S1.1 recall the conjecture. The plan never states what an eventual lower bound means or the liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 negation (381-387).

errors.says: The rounds on prefix slots process their bits individually 'at cost O(Tp) per round' and O(TpdK) in total.
errors.paper: O(Tp) is the cost of the moves and scans for one participating bit processed individually (3106-3114). A prefix round has up to D<=d such bits, so it costs O(TpD), and the at most b+1<=K rounds give O(TpdK) (3127-3128). 'O(Tp) per round' would give only O(TpK) and contradicts the plan's own total.

errors.says: Each edge's frame change is a product of kernels summing to s_c, 'and the telescoped endpoint operator is C^{⊗m} on every role'.
errors.paper: Telescoping alone gives C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates of u_a for the pair X_a->Y_a (1287-1298), together with the sign of the scalar exchange. C^{⊗m} on every role holds only 'after source and sink diagonal corrections, and undoing the signed bank exchange' (1225-1228, 1300-1314). The plan supplies these corrections later, in S2.6.11-S2.6.13.

chain: Yes. The plan follows the paper's route and order. S2 builds both power-saving procedures from one rank-saving network: frames (S2.4), labels and budget (S2.5), the rational interface (S2.5.6), the phase interface (S2.6), the exponent (S2.6.14), shears (S2.8), the interchange recurrence (S2.9-S2.10) and the butterfly layer (S2.11-S2.12). It then goes through transforms (S3), convolution (S4), resampling, chirp and cancellation (S5), and parameters, CRT, twist, the source transform, the algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table (S6), reaching O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) with kappa=2^{-182}. It thins out only at the edges: h=100 and the wire counts W_b, W_c are never given, so the loss ratios and eta are quoted rather than computed; the rational-unit scalings of the controlled-shift lemma are dropped; and the disproof of the conjecture is only asserted in S0.

steps.note: The network is reconstructed in full: copy, side, gather and scatter gates on triples, three stages, (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), and every auxiliary wire restored. Data are indexed through u_a=t_{a1}⊗t_{a2}⊗t_{a3}, m is the dimension of F^{⊗3} with F=Q^h, and N is the sum of source dimensions. But h=100 is never stated, and N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 appear only implicitly. I judged this reconstructed because the mechanism and its role are explicit, with this caveat.

The plan states that a common frame per gate commutes with pointwise gates by R-linearity, that the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and that intermediate frames are free so that each edge is only a change of frame (S2.4 motivation).
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} of dimension m are assigned to gates. Every edge joins comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges are the central wires 3->4, each losing P⊗F of dimension h.
The plan states rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate U⊂V, and the N exceptions where the first edge on X_a is 2P_{U_a} of rank one.
The plan has sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich from telescoping, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b once the N extra source ranks are added.
The plan gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0), and hence s<Wm.

The plan states M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m, from P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m for X_a and zero/identity for the other roles. With frames Phi_M, the bit network then applies H<-H+D on every role, including scratch rows.
The plan states A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones in Pi, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) (triangular parts by controlled shifts), and therefore s recursive calls per node.
The plan has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and tau=1-2^{-50} from eta > 20*2^{-50} and log m<20 giving s/W<m^tau, so F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: P17 reconstructs the whole central saving in S2.3-S2.9 and S2.6.14, almost entirely with verbatim quotes at the correct lines. It covers the bank-exchange network, frames, nested subspace labels with the single decreasing central edge, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, the strict saving from L/N=100/539, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, edges as rank-many interchanges via E_1 Pi E_2, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only thin point is C1: h=100 is never fixed, and N and m are carried only implicitly.
